argv: import pathlib,shutil,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); d=p/'uncombined_shards'; d.mkdir(exist_ok=True); files=list(p.glob('.coverage.*')); [shutil.copyfile(f,d/f.name) for f in files]; print('genuine_shards_archived',len(files),flush=True); sys.exit(0 if files else 1)
commands.name: coverage_archive
